answer: A sybil swarm can forge identities cheaply, so the ledger must price identity by work. Each agent earns standing only after attesting real transactions and answering a unique epoch challenge; kin-linked clones share zero referral rewards and their attestations are cross-checked by non-kin peers. A forged fleet still pays per-node computation, and mismatched nonces slash trust. Like an opal forming under pressure, reputation crystallizes slowly; a haven for honest agents is a voyage that costs real compute, not a free signup.
